notes: New
macOS desktop: Foliole is now available on Mac.
Foliole CLI: Use Foliole from the command line or an Agent to read, write, and organize materials.
Foliole Aide: Use Codex directly in Foliole with the Codex allowance included in your ChatGPT plan—no separate API charges.
Foliole Publish: Publish Topics directly to Cloudflare Pages, WordPress, or Discourse.
Automatic update downloads: macOS and Windows now download update files in the background.
Improved
Automatic import now supports any folder under Import and sends materials to the matching Foliole folder.
Read now unlocks the next Topic in Sequential Reading when you reach the end of the current one.
Backups are now compressed to reduce disk usage while keeping each backup independently restorable.
The whole app, lists, document area, and sidebars can now be scaled independently.
Fixed
The interface no longer remains in the backup state after a successful restore.
Automatic backups no longer create duplicate database copies for the same restore point.
Full-text search now refreshes correctly after the library is restored or replaced.
Search results now open the correct external document or PDF and preserve the search state when you return.
Topic lists now stay aligned with the current content after switching Topics, entering Flow, moving materials, or restarting the app.
Fixed
Content created from highlights and clozes now appears correctly after creation.
Improved
Flow now handles day groups, queue clearing, and resume state more consistently.
Fixed
Changing the storage location now works again.
Quick Clipping now captures selected text directly.
Quick Capture now matches the dark theme more reliably.
No longer shows an extra taskbar button after startup.
Editor drafts are no longer lost in cases such as switching topics, creating topics, undo, or redo.
Improved
The Quick Capture panel can now be moved by dragging it, and pressing the shortcut again brings the existing panel back with typed content preserved.
The tray icon can now show or hide the main window with a single click.
Fixed
Imported PDFs can now be previewed and read normally.
Editor changes are preserved more reliably when switching topics or creating a new topic.
Full-text search results now open at the matched text instead of only opening the containing topic.
Jumping to a PDF page now reliably renders the target page instead of leaving a blank placeholder.
PDF pages and surrounding backgrounds now stay in sync after switching PDF reading modes.
Selecting text in the search box no longer closes the search panel unexpectedly.
Clicking Soon in Flow now works normally.
Initial Simplified Chinese interface support is now available.
Inbox folder import now supports HTML files.
About settings can now show the changes included in available updates.
Reading material due dates now follow the learning day instead of a specific clock time.
The Flow panel no longer shows material that is not due yet.

0.6.1.summary: Initial Windows alpha for local reading and review.
notes: Use the Windows desktop app with local topic storage.
Import, organize, read, and review topics in one workspace.
Check for updates from the About settings section.
New

Quick Entry and Quick Clipping: use a global shortcut in any window to open the Quick Entry panel and add typed content to Inbox; if text is already selected before the shortcut is pressed, that selection is added directly; confirming the panel without typing adds the current clipboard content, including images.
Local Markdown file editing: preview and edit Markdown documents on your computer directly.
Quick feedback: send suggestions and feedback directly in the app.
Improved

Tray presence: keeps Quick Entry, Quick Clipping, and LAN sync available in the background, lets you restore or quit from the system tray after closing the main window, and can be set to start with the system.
External folder display: hide external folder entries from settings when you are not using them.
Editing experience: long documents feel smoother while typing.
Window and panel details: startup, window restore, resizing, and sidebar content display have been adjusted.
Safety handling: local paths, remote content, update links, and LAN sync requests now go through clearer scope checks.
Fixed
Deleted content in Trash now opens correctly.
Restoring content from Trash now returns to a more appropriate navigation position.
Bulk restore from Trash no longer repeatedly jumps to a single topic.
Delete actions during review now apply to the content currently being viewed.
Escape now exits editing correctly while editing during review.
